coverageNote: Main and full Electron regression, both typechecks and production build passed on final source. Wide/dark and narrow/light pending-data screenshots inspected.
regressions: Failed pasted-data attachment at the five-file limit or simulated disk failure retains exact raw text and blocks save/send until successful retry or explicit discard.
File removal, raw-text editing, retry, collapse/reopen and manual Paste data remain available while pending; discard clears source/error and restores save.
Successful retry persists local file refs through save/reopen, then Upload imports both recipients; raw data remains absent from draft metadata and AI request/history.
Campaign name and email subject instructions before/after CSV, including comma/semicolon, stay in description/history; exact standalone column headers stay with data.
Fixture name patch survives save/reopen while CSV source stays exact; existing large/quoted/blank-row, draft, undo, cancellation and platform regressions pass.
limitations: Renderer uses fixture IPC/stores/provider, not production provider or DB; no live-model intent canary.
No Windows installer or manual production-app verification in this fix.
Pending raw text is transient; explicitly closing the entire form discards unsaved changes as before.
database: No migration/RPC/ACL/connection changes or DB apply
release: Source and local production build only; no installer/release
